title: Cardinals-Panthers set for Aug. 6 HOF game

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Cardinals-Panthers set for Aug. 6 HOF game
sources.description: The Arizona Cardinals will take on the Carolina Panthers in the annual Hall of Fame exhibition game on Aug. 6 as part of enshrinement week, with Cardinals legend Larry Fitzgerald and Panthers great Luke Kuechly set for enshrinement.
